fields.name: Timelines
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1D7A710 zero-initialises a 64-byte hash map (hash set of keys + value array); destructor bg3.exe+0x5C4870 frees the value array at +0x30 without per-element destructors. Key = 2 bytes: bg3.exe+0x1D34EC0 (ecl::sound::SneakStateSystem update) walks the key array at +0x20 as shorts (count at +0x2C) and matches them against a set of player ids. Value = 16 bytes: lookup bg3.exe+0x1D159C0 (key short, hashed by value) returns values + index*0x10; bg3.exe+0x1D99430 compares the two qwords of the value with +0x08/+0x10 of a 0xA8-byte component (eoc::TimelineDataComponent::InstanceId). Singleton getter bg3.exe+0x1D3DAA0 confirms stride 0x40. Probe: 1 key, value capacity 1 (one local player in a dialogue).

open_questions: The Guid is taken to be the timeline instance id (it is compared with TimelineDataComponent+0x08 = InstanceId); the function that inserts entries (inside ecl::TimelineSystem, registered by bg3.exe+0x732470) was not read.
